Fred Couples Golf.name: Fred Couples Golf
Fred Couples Golf.summary: Fred Couples Golf is a handheld golf sim where you compete across four courses in tournament, stroke, or match play. Customize player names, shirts, difficulty, and caddies. The game offers overhead course views for shot planning, practice mode, and four‑player link play, while Fred Couples appears as an opponent only.

Land of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse.name: Land of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse
Land of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse.summary: Mickey finds himself in a fairy tale land where an evil Phantom-in-the-Clouds has stolen a special gem which brought peace and prosperity to a tiny village. It's up to you to help him save the day - and earn a place in Minnie's heart!
